lines.zh: 我贴着沙面爬，腹部拖着
lines.en: I crawl close to the sand, abdomen dragging.

lines.zh: 我的背上有一处会发光
lines.en: A glowing spot sits on my back.

lines.zh: 六条腿交替动，速度不慢
lines.en: Six legs work in turn; I am not slow.
I move at night, and the light moves with me.

lines.zh: 我的光一闪一闪，很有节奏
lines.en: My light blinks in a rhythm.
I work my way across the sand toward you.

lines.zh: 我的节肢在沙上留细痕
lines.en: My legs leave fine lines in the sand.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘的一侧爬到另一侧
lines.en: I climb from one side of the dune to the other.
I stop, and the light stops.

lines.zh: 我绕开一块石头，继续走
lines.en: I go around a stone and keep going.

lines.zh: 我的身体是暗的，光是从里面出来的
lines.en: My body is dark; the light comes from within.

lines.zh: 我走得很稳，不发出声音
lines.en: I move steadily, without sound.

lines.zh: 我伏在沙上，光在慢慢亮
lines.en: I lie on the sand, my light slowly brightening.
I wait for full dark.
My light reaches a few meters.
The sand is cool; good for night.

lines.zh: 我的口器很小，咬不穿硬的
lines.en: My mouthparts are small; they cannot pierce hard things.
I listen to what moves under the sand.
My light suddenly dims.
Someone has seen my light.
I edge forward a little at a time.

lines.zh: 我不需要跑，光会引它们来
lines.en: I need not run; the light draws them.
Fine hairs cover my abdomen.
The desert is empty at night.
I stop, my light aimed at you.
My light flares once.
You should not look at this.
I am at your feet, very close.

lines.zh: 你的影子被我的光照出来
lines.en: My light throws your shadow.
My legs grip the sand.
This is no lure; this is me.

lines.zh: 我看见你的眼睛在反光
lines.en: I see your eyes catch my light.

lines.zh: 我们之间没有别的东西
lines.en: Nothing lies between us.
I am patient; the light stays on.
You retreat, and the light follows.

lines.zh: 我尾后的光，是给虫群看的。
lines.en: The light on my tail signals the swarm.

lines.zh: 我的光在你脸上闪了三次
lines.en: My light blinks three times on your face.
Now you know where I am.
My light goes out for half a second.
I cannot cry out; my light flickers wildly.

lines.zh: 这一下打碎了我的腹节
lines.en: That cracked my abdomen segment.
I retreat, and the light retreats with me.
I curl up, my light dimming.

lines.zh: 液体从伤口渗出来，发亮
lines.en: Fluid seeps from the wound, glowing.
I should not have been in the light.
My light is half as strong.
I have kept your shape.
The light is not for you to see.
You hold something up; I am not interested.
I only want to come closer.
Set it down and free your hands.

lines.zh: 这味道不对，我的颚不张。
lines.en: Wrong scent; my mandibles stay shut.

lines.zh: 我的光在它上面照了照
lines.en: My light plays over it.
I go around it, toward you.

lines.zh: 这东西会反光，我很喜欢
lines.en: This reflects; I like it.
You hit me and my light wavers.
I give half a foot; the light remains.

lines.zh: 我的腿断了两条，还能走
lines.en: Two legs broken; I can still move.

lines.zh: 这一下把沙扑了我一身
lines.en: That threw sand over me.
I press against your leg.
You did not kick me off.

lines.zh: 我的光在你身上印出一块
lines.en: My light leaves a spot on you.
I slowly circle behind you.
We churn the sand.

lines.zh: 我不退，我本来就不该在这
lines.en: I do not retreat; I should not be here at all.
We find each other by light.
At night all our lights look the same.

lines.zh: 我的闪法跟别的不一样
lines.en: My blink pattern is not like the others.
We blink at each other a long while.
Something will be left under the sand.
The swarm does not care about this.
The other's light is weaker than mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起走，光就连成一条
lines.en: Walking together, our lights form a line.

lines.zh: 天亮了，我们就看不见了
lines.en: At dawn we can no longer see each other.

lines.zh: 前腿一合，这颗果子归我。
lines.en: My forelegs close; this fruit is mine.
It reflects light beneath me.
This cannot pass my mouthparts.
I push it into the sand.
Holding it, my light dims a little.
It is wider than my head.
I set it down and keep moving.
I tuck it under myself.
I do not want this.
It rolled down the dune; I did not follow.
My light has found you.
I press my body to the sand.
I make no sound, only light.

lines.zh: 你的影子很长，我看得清
lines.en: Your shadow is long; I see it clearly.
Your prints are in the sand.
I begin to close in.
They will come to the light.
Stand there and do not move.
I flashed three times.
The light is moving at you.
You have walked into my light.
I keep you pinned inside the light.
The swarm waits under the sand.

lines.zh: 我的光照到你了，这个距离够了。
lines.en: My light has found you; this range is enough.
I follow you, light steady.
You round a dune; so do I.
I am slow, but I keep glowing.
I dim my light.
You look back, and I stop.

lines.zh: 沙下的震动告诉我你在哪
lines.en: Tremors in the sand tell me where you are.
I flash once so you can see me.
You have backed off a long way.

lines.zh: 我背上那处光，一直跟着你。
lines.en: The glow on my back keeps following you.
At last, the light goes out.

lines.zh: 虫群的味道，从你那边飘来。
lines.en: The swarm's scent drifts over from your side.
I switch off the light and strike.

lines.zh: 我在沙丘上跟着你的影子
lines.en: I follow your shadow along the dune.

lines.zh: 你每走一段，我就亮一下
lines.en: Every stretch you walk, I flash once.

lines.zh: 我把沙拨开，让路好走些
lines.en: I clear the sand to make the way easier.
Your steps sink deep in the sand.
I wait for the swarm to close in.
I spring onto your leg.

lines.zh: 翅膜一振，我撞上你的脖子。
lines.en: Wings humming, I strike your neck.
My light pulses against you.
You shake, and I do not fall.
The bite is shallow, but it stings.
My leg broke; I can still bite.
You stomp; I dodge.
I press against you again.
My light is growing weaker.
The swarm will come after.

lines.zh: 你被我的光照得看不清
lines.en: My light keeps you from seeing clearly.

lines.zh: 我停下，看你还有多少力气
lines.en: I stop and see how much you have left.
A point of light appears on the sand.
I crawl up out of the sand layer.
Night is right; the light carries far.

lines.zh: 这里没有别人，只有虫群
lines.en: No one else here, only the swarm.
My light comes on for the first time.
I listen first, look next, then move.
The desert heat has not gone.

lines.zh: 我从别的虫后面绕出来
lines.en: I come around behind the other bugs.
My light sways on the sand.

lines.zh: 远处的沙丘上还有几个光点
lines.en: More lights on the distant dunes.
I head for the darkest place.
I flash three times to call my kind.

lines.zh: 我落下来的地方是个沙坑
lines.en: I land in a hollow of sand.

lines.zh: 第一个看见我的人，会先愣住
lines.en: The first one to see me will freeze.
The light is my name.
I wait for you to notice me.
I shut my light and open it again.

lines.zh: 火比我的光亮太多，我退开
lines.en: The fire is far brighter than my light; I retreat.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘上滚下去，光一路翻
lines.en: I roll down the dune, my light tumbling.
Water presses me down; the light blinks below.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的光全打散了
lines.en: The blast scatters my light entirely.
Something pierces my abdomen.

lines.zh: 那股力把我的光按住了
lines.en: That force presses my light flat.

lines.zh: 沙里没什么可吃，我越来越弱
lines.en: Little to eat in the sand; I weaken.

lines.zh: 雷光比我的亮太多，我什么都看不见
lines.en: The lightning is far brighter; I see nothing.

lines.zh: 沙没有了，我的光在空里
lines.en: No sand; my light hangs in nothing.
